review_mode: Codex author self-review; candidate task acceptance only

criteria.criterion: Accept scoped extension readiness only when every hard obligation for that scope is discharged.
criteria.finding: All five L2 predecessor receipts and their scoped dependencies are current; the exact nine non-rule obligations are discharged and the three compatibility dimensions remain separate for the fresh annotation proposal.

criteria.criterion: Record the L3 handoff containing required rule obligations; G2 does not depend on their future discharge.
criteria.finding: The L3 handoff exports the exact rule proposal and complete independently generated requirements, including six still-pending rule obligations; no G2-to-I06 cycle or premature rule authorization is introduced.

failure_controls.control: Do not label rule-changing proposals fully ready at this gate.
failure_controls.finding: Rule-changing readiness remains pending-L3 and the actual I06/G3 gates are required before full rule use.

failure_controls.control: Unsupported conservativity or preservation claims require narrowing.
failure_controls.finding: Unknown old-language constraints cannot reuse these preservation/conservativity theorems and require a separately formalized profile; the baseline semantic unknowns remain explicit.
